messages.subject: QTL peak thresholds
parts:
I'm trying to make code that can scan through a large list of genes, and find genes with QTL peaks above a certain threshold within this list. To do this, I was using the max() function. However, I recently realized that the max() function only finds the max on one position of the chromosome on which we are analyzing. Is there a way to scan through all of the positions quickly? Our dataset is pretty large, so while we probably could set up a loop to go through every position, it would probably take a huge amount of time.

Here is the part of the code we were having trouble with:

all.scan1a <- scanone(f2g, pheno.col=c(4:16680), addcovar=sex, method="hk")
max <- max(all.scan1a, chr=7)

Are you trying to find the peak LOD score (value and position) on that chromosome for each of the phenotypes?
